steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: Persuasive writing aims to convince the reader to agree with your viewpoint or take a specific action. It uses a range of techniques to appeal to logic, emotion, and credibility. | : Introduction: Hook the reader with a striking opening State your viewpoint clearly Outline what you'll discuss | : Main Body: Present your strongest argument first Support each point with evidence Use a new paragraph for each point Address counter-arguments | : Conclusion: Summarise your main points Reinforce your viewpoint End with a powerful call to action

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Name three persuasive techniques and explain how each works. | Why is it important to address counter-arguments in persuasive writing? | Write an opening paragraph persuading your school to introduce a healthy eating policy.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on Useful phrases for counter-arguments, Examiner's Tip, Persuasive Writing Exam Strategy, and one past-paper question.
